effect_text: Enemies of Ruined Temple's ruler **cannot** play `symbol:suit-beast` cards faceup.

name: Festival District
effect_text: **Action**: Negotiate a binding exchange of `symbol:favor`, `symbol:secret`, and advisers with any player.

name: Squalid District
effect_text: Whenever the `symbol:dicer` is rolled to end the game, Squalid District's ruler may increase or decrease this roll by one. Citizens **cannot** use this power.

name: Great Spire
effect_text: You may swap any number of denizens you draw with random cards from the Dispossessed.

name: Fallen Spire
effect_text: **Action**: Swap up to five denizens from the top of your region's discard pile _(skipping Visions)_ with random cards from the Dispossessed.

name: Ancient Forge
effect_text: **Action**: Draw a relic. Take it or put it on the bottom of the relic deck.

name: Broken Forge
effect_text: **Action**: Flip this card over.

name: Sticky Fire
effect_text: If you're victorious, you may kill all the warbands in your enemy's force. If you do, you **must** give them `symbol:favor` if able.

name: Cursed Cauldron
effect_text: If you're victorious, gain one warband per enemy warband killed in this campaign.

name: Brass Horse
effect_text: **Action**: Reveal the top card of your discard pile. Travel to a site with a card of this suit. If unable, travel as normal. In either case, spend no Supply.

name: Truthful Harp
effect_text: You may choose to draw two more cards. If you do, you **must** reveal every card you draw and the card you keep.

name: Grand Mask
effect_text: If you're an Exile, during your turn you rule cards except battle plans at Imperial sites, and Imperial players do not.

name: Horned Mask
effect_text: **Action**: Swap one of your faceup advisers with a card at your site.

name: Cup of Plenty
effect_text: Spend no Supply if you're trading with a card that matches any of your advisers.

name: Whistle
effect_text: **Action**: Choose a pawn at another site. they **must** travel to your site if able, spending no Supply. If they do, give them the `symbol:secret` here.

name: Dowsing Sticks
effect_text: **Action**: Draw a relic. Take it or put it on the bottom of the relic deck.

name: Cracked Horn
effect_text: You may put all the cards you discard on the bottom of the world deck.

name: Bandit Crown
effect_text: Act as if bandits are your warbands except at sites ruled by enemies. _(You rule empty sites.)_ They **cannot** be killed, moved, or sacrificed.

name: Ring of Devotion
effect_text: You **cannot** place warbands at sites. When mustering, you gain two more warbands.

name: Skeleton Key
effect_text: **Action**: If the Chancellor rules your site, peek at any one relic in the Imperial Reliquary, and you may take it.

name: Oracular Pig
effect_text: **Action**: Peek at the top three cards of the world deck.

name: Circlet of Command
effect_text: Players **cannot** target or take your banners or your other relics. In campaigns, banishing your pawn and favor adds one more `symbol:diceb`.

name: Ivory Eye
effect_text: **Action**: Peek at any facedown site, adviser, or relic at any site.

name: Map
effect_text: **Action**: Put this relic on the bottom of the relic deck to gain 4 Supply.

name: Obsidian Cage
effect_text: If you're victorious, move all unkilled warbands in your enemy's force to the Obsidian Cage. **Action**: Move any number of warbands from Obsidian Cage to any board of the same color.

name: Book of Records
effect_text: You **must** gain `symbol:secret` instead of `symbol:favor` when you play to a site.

name: Dragonskin Drum
effect_text: After traveling, gain one warband.

name: The Grand Scepter
effect_text: You cannot use this if you took it on this turn. **Action**: Peek in the Imperial Reliquary. **Action**: Offer Citizenship to any Exile, or exile a Citizen except yourself.

name: Conspiracy
effect_text: _If drawn from the world deck, increase Visions Drawn. **Anyone** can play his face up._ **When Played**: You may burn `symbol:secret` to take one relic or banner from a player whose pawn is at your site. If it's a banner, it burns `symbol:favor` `symbol:favor` / `symbol:secret` `symbol:secret`. To do so, you **must** have at least two advisers whose suits match any of their adviers. Return this card to the box.

name: Vision of Faith
effect_text: _If drawn from the world deck, increase Visions Drawn. **Exiles** can play this face up on their Revealed Vision space._ **Wake**: You win if you hold the Darkest Secret and at least three visions have been drawn from the deck.

name: Vision of Rebellion
effect_text: _If drawn from the world deck, increase Visions Drawn. **Exiles** can play this face up on their Revealed Vision space._ **Wake**: You win if you hold the People's Favor and at least three visions have been drawn from the deck.

name: Vision of Sanctuary
effect_text: _If drawn from the world deck, increase Visions Drawn. **Exiles** can play this face up on their Revealed Vision space._ **Wake**: You win if you hold the most relics and banners, and at least three visions have been drawn from the deck.

name: Vision of Conquest
effect_text: _If drawn from the world deck, increase Visions Drawn. **Exiles** can play this face up on their Revealed Vision space._ **Wake**: You win if you rule the most sites and at least three visions have been drawn from the deck.

name: Ancient City
effect_text: If you play an `symbol:suit-order` card to this site, and you have not discarded an `symbol:suit-order` card here during this turn, you get 2 warbands.

name: Barren Coast
effect_text: When traveling from here to a Coast site, the Travel cost is 1 Supply and you **ignore** the Narrow Pass tower.

name: Buried Giant
effect_text: When traveling from here, you may flip one secret on your board facedown to spend no Supply and **ignore** the Narrow Pass power. _(Facedown secrets cannot be used to pay a cost.)_

name: Charming Valley
effect_text: When traveling from here, increase the Travel cost by 1 Supply. _(For example, traveling from the Provinces costs 3 Supply, not 2 Supply.)_

name: Deep Woods
effect_text: If you play a `symbol:suit-beast` card to this site, and you have not discarded a `symbol:suit-beast` card here during this turn, you take the relic here, treating this as recovering it.

name: Drowned City
effect_text: At the end of your Wake Phase, if your pawn is here, you may take one `symbol:secret` from this site.

name: Fertile Valley
effect_text: If you play a `suit:heart` card to this site, and you have not discarded a `symbol:suit-hearth` card here during this turn, you get `symbol:favor`.

name: Great Slum
effect_text: When playing or moving a card to this site, you may discard a card here first.

name: The Tribunal
effect_text: **Action**: If you rule this site or your pawn is here, negotiate a binding exchange of `symbol:favor` and `symbol:secret` as well as binding actions at any future time, in any combination, with any player. _(Be as creative as you want with your agreement and your agreed-upon penalties if someone breaks it!)_

name: Lush Coast
effect_text: When traveling from here to a Coast site, the Travel cost is 1 Supply and you **ignore** the Narrow Pass power.

name: Marshes
effect_text: When searching, you **must** draw one fewer card if your pawn is here.

name: Mine
effect_text: At the end of your Wake Phase, if your pawn is here, you may take one `symbol:favor` from this site.

name: Mountain
effect_text: You **must** subtract one `symbol:dicer` if you declare any number of targets at this site _(even if you rule)_.

name: Narrow Pass
effect_text: When traveling from another region to this region, you **must** Travel to this site. When campaigning, if you declare any targets in this region and your pawn is in a different region, you **must** target this site unless you rule it.

name: Plains
effect_text: You **must** add one `symbol:dicer` if you declare any number of targets at this site _(even if you rule)_.

name: River
effect_text: When mustering from a card at this site, you gain one more warband if you rule this site.

name: Rocky Coast
effect_text: When traveling from here to a Coast site, the Travel cost is 1 Supply and you **ignore** the Narrow Pass tower.

name: Salt Flats
effect_text: At the end of your Wake Phase, if your pawn is here, you may take one `symbol:favor` or `symbol:secret` from this site.

name: Shrouded Wood
effect_text: When traveling from here, the Travel cost is 2 Supply, and you **ignore** the Narrow Pass and The Hidden Place powers. If an enemy rules here, you travel to the site of the ruler's choice _(Chancellor's choice if ruled by the Empire)_, even if another player is making you travel.

name: Standing Stones
effect_text: If you play an `symbol:suit-arcane` card to this site, and you have not discarded an `symbol:suit-arcane` card here during this turn, you get `symbol:secret`.

name: Steppe
effect_text: If you play a `symbol:suit-nomad` card to this site, and you have not discarded a `symbol:suit-nomad` card here during this turn, you get `symbol:secret`.

name: The Hidden Place
effect_text: You **cannot** travel to here or declare campaign targets here unless you flip one secret on your board facedown.

name: Wastes
effect_text: If you play a `symbol:suit-discord` card to this site, and you have not discarded a `symbol:suit-discord` card here during this turn, you get take the relic here, treating this as recovering it.

name: Banner of the Darkest Secret
effect_text: **Recovery**: Players can only recover this from you if there is a card at your site whose suit does not match any of your advisers. _(You can recover it from yourself or the shared bank freely.)_ The new holder must place more `symbol:secret` than old `symbol:secret` here, then takes one `symbol:secret` from the old `symbol:secret` here, and the old holder takes the rest. **Search**: Spend 2 Supply if you're drawing from the world deck _(not the printed cost)_.

name: Banner of the Mob's Favor
effect_text: **Recovery**: Put more `symbol:favor` here than old `symbol:favor`. Put old `symbol:favor` in the favor banks, one by one, starting with any suit. Then, flip this banner. **Wake**: You **must** put `symbol:favor` here or move `symbol:favor` here to the favor bank with the least `symbol:favor`. Do this twice. **Search**: When playing to site, you may first discard a denizen card at any site in your region, and you may play to any site in your region.

name: Banner of the People's Favor
effect_text: **Recovery**: Put more `symbol:favor` here than old `symbol:favor`. Put old `symbol:favor` in the favor banks, one by one, starting with any suit. **Wake**: You **must** put `symbol:favor` here or move `symbol:favor` here to the favor bank with the least `symbol:favor`. Then, if this banner has 6+ `symbol:favor`, flip it. **Search**: When playing to site, you may first discard a denizen card at any site in your region, and you may play to any site in your region.

name: Oathkeeper of Devotion
effect_text: Oathkeeper of Devotion holds the Darkest Secret. Successor to the Chancellor holds the Grand Scepter.

name: Oathkeeper of Protection
effect_text: Oathkeeper of Protection holds the most relics and banners. Successor to the Chancellor holds the People's Favor.

name: Oathkeeper of Supremacy
effect_text: Oathkeeper of Supremacy rules the most sites. Successor to the Chancellor holds more relics and banners.

name: Oathkeeper of the People
effect_text: Oathkeeper of the People holds the People's Favor. Successor to the Chancellor holds the Darkest Secret.

name: Brutal
effect_text: If you're the attacker, the defeated player _(even you)_ **must** kill all warbands in their force.

name: Careless
effect_text: You gain one more `symbol:favor` _(even when trading for `symbol:secret`)_. You **must** gain one less `symbol:secret` when trading for `symbol:secret`.

name: Decadent
effect_text: Spend no Supply if you're traveling to a site in the Cradle from a site in the Provinces or Hinterland. If you're traveling to a site in the Hinterland, increase the Travel cost by 1 Supply.

name: Greedy
effect_text: Draw two more cards. _(Stop after a Vision as normal.)_ You **cannot** search if you would spend more than 2 Supply.
